The sample size a target power implies

Source: R/ilm_power.R, R/zzz-iml-aliases.R
ilm_power_n.Rd

Interpolates the simulated curve, and reports the range the Monte Carlo error allows rather than a single number the simulation cannot support.

Usage

ilm_power_n(object, target = 0.8)

Arguments

object

An ilm_power() result.

target

Power to reach.

Value

A data frame with one row per effect size: the interpolated n, and the n_lower/n_upper implied by the Monte Carlo interval. For a result from ilm_power_design() it also carries n_unit, the same figure in participants rather than rows.

See also

ilm_power().
